newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Mosenergo sees 3.4 trln rbl 1997 pretax profit.
newsitem.headline: Mosenergo sees 3.4 trln rbl 1997 pretax profit.

text.p: Russian regional utility Mosenergo expects its pretax profit to fall to 3.4 trillion roubles this year after rising to an expected 3.9 trillion in 1996 from 3.42 trillion in 1995, a senior company official said on Monday.
The figures are to Russian accounting standards.

Natalya Khokholkova, head of the securities department at OAO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii Mosenergo, told Reuters that net profit this year was planned at 2.46 trillion roubles after an expected 2.75 trillion roubles in 1996 and 2.45 trillion in 1995.
"We do indeed expect a certain fall in profits in 1997 but only because we are not raising charges, as agreed with the Moscow municipal government," she said.

Last week Interfax news agency quoted Mosenergo chief executive Nestor Serebryanikov as saying pre-tax profit would drop in 1997 to 2.22 trillion roubles from 3.94 trillion in 1996, and net profit would fall to 1.5 trillion from 2.8 trillion.
The report depressed Mosenergo shares, which were trading at $1.42 at 1300 GMT on the Russian Trading System after closing on Friday at $1.46.
Kholkholkova said Serebryanikov's words had been distorted.
